title: Cache for the thumbnail service
intro: Two open points before the cache is built. The recommended option comes first and is preselected.

questions.text:
Settled and not up for decision here:

- thumbnails stay PNG
- the cache lives in the service's own process
- no new dependency
How does the cache drop thumbnails once it is full?

options.label: Least recently used
options.description: Keeps the thumbnails people open again. One more list to keep in step with the map.

options.label: Oldest first
options.description: The simplest to write. It drops thumbnails that are still opened often.

questions.text:
How much memory may the cache take?

The service runs in a container with 2 GB.

context.title: Memory today
context.content:
| Part | Memory |
|:--|--:|
| the service, idle | 180 MB |
| one resize in flight | 60 MB |
| at most 8 resizes | 480 MB |

options.label: 256 MB
options.description: Holds about 4000 thumbnails, which covers the front page.

options.label: 1 GB
options.description: Holds about 16000 thumbnails and leaves 364 MB of the 2 GB.

options.label: No limit
options.description: Grows until the container is killed.
